title: Waffle weave cotton kitchen towels
text: Waffle weave cotton kitchen towels. These are a nice medium gray (in my opinion) - cotton.  Washed up in the washer and dryer great.  The towels are just right for my kitchen.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: COTTON CRAFT Amazing Kitchen Towels - 8 Pack - 100% Cotton Euro Café Waffle Weave Dish Towels Set - Soft Absorbent Quick Dry Low Lint - Reusable Terry Pantry Bar Cleaning Cloth - Large 16 x 28 - Red
features: SET CONTENTS: Each set includes eight (8) COTTON CRAFT Waffle Weave Kitchen Towels, each measuring 16 inches by 28 inches (16"x28")
STYLISH & FUNCTIONAL: Keep COTTON CRAFT's kitchen towels handy in your home for washing, drying and tackling any kitchen messes
GOURMET DECOR: Enhance your kitchen with the professional-grade quality of our Euro Cafe towels
ECO-FRIENDLY: Go green and replace your single-use paper towels with 100% pure cotton kitchen towels, made from all-natural fibers

EASY CARE: All COTTON CRAFT kitchen towels/tea towels/dishcloths are easy care. Machine wash on gentle cycle to reduce the possibility of shrinkage. Tumble dry low. NOTE: Due to the nature of the cotton fabric, some minimal shrinkage may occur.
